items.title: Roger Kellaway interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999
items.q: The other person it happened with was Maynard Ferguson, who actually offered me the job on bass or piano, whatever I wanted. I reminded him of that a year ago when we had dinner together

ctx.x: And ’63, early 60s you started getting out with some of the well known names.

Well I arrived in New York in 1960. Here’s an interesting story. I arrived, and the first night I meet Bill Takas, the bass player. And he takes me to the Five Spot and introduces me to Jimmy Giuffre. I sit in with Jimmy Giuffre and I’m actually offered the job on bass. Now as it turns out, I didn’t take it obviously. The next group he had was Paul Bley and Steve Swallow. And that was, he wanted a band of composers. That happened to me twice. The other person it happened with was Maynard Ferguson, who actually…
Clark’s a great fellow to work with I would imagine.
